doc_content: Sprint planning sets the goals for a 2-week sprint. The retrospective at the end reviews what went well, what did not, and what to improve. Sprint velocity is measured in story points completed per sprint. Daily standups keep the team aligned during the sprint.

Docker containers communicate over virtual networks. The bridge network is the default for single-host networking. Overlay networks enable multi-host container communication. Port binding maps container ports to host ports using -p flag.

JWT (JSON Web Tokens) are a compact way to securely transmit information. A JWT consists of a header, payload, and signature. The Authorization header carries the bearer token: Authorization: Bearer <token>. Tokens expire after a configured TTL.

Database indexes speed up query execution by creating a lookup structure. B-tree indexes are suited for range queries. Composite indexes cover multi-column WHERE clauses. An index on a frequently filtered column can reduce full-table scans dramatically.

Python's asyncio library enables asynchronous programming. A coroutine is defined with async def and paused with await. The event loop runs coroutines concurrently without threads. asyncio.gather() runs multiple coroutines in parallel.

Overfitting occurs when a model memorizes training data but fails to generalize. L1 regularization (Lasso) adds the absolute weight sum to the loss. L2 regularization (Ridge) adds squared weights. Dropout randomly zeroes neurons during training to prevent co-adaptation.

Git merge conflicts occur when two branches modify the same lines. During conflict resolution, <<<<<<< marks the current branch changes and >>>>>>> marks the incoming branch. git mergetool launches a visual diff editor. Rebasing replays commits on top of another branch to keep a linear history.

A Kubernetes Deployment manages a set of replica Pods. The spec.replicas field controls the desired number of running pods. Horizontal Pod Autoscaler scales replicas based on CPU or custom metrics. Rolling updates replace pods gradually to avoid downtime.
